title: Tôi không đồng ý với mức giá đó
englishTitle: I did not agree to that price
pronunciation: Toi khong dong y voi muc gia do
summary: I did not agree to that price

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Keep the receipt, menu, booking, or earlier app price visible so the disagreement stays specific.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Start with Tôi không đồng ý với mức giá đó; then point to the location, passport copy, photo, injury, or helper contact if the other person needs context. Say Tôi không đồng ý với mức giá đó, then show the earlier price.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Build the line around Tôi không + đồng ý với, then replay the full phrase until the rhythm feels natural.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Good next-step cards: Call the police, Call an ambulance, and I lost my passport.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Say it before paying or leaving the counter. If possible, show the earlier price instead of arguing from memory.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Keep the line short; the evidence should do most of the work.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Use these when the exchange shifts toward I feel unsafe, this is an emergency, and help!
